messages:
deploy-bot: Release r2026.3 kickoff: services=[runtime, api, console, router] canary=10% window=15m. Rollout ID=rl-2026-03. /watch https://deploys.internal/rl-2026-03
sam: ack — starting canary. console migration included?
mira: console migration is behind feature-flag, no DB schema. safe to proceed from console side.
jyoti: FYI I saw a small kv-eviction tweak in runtime perf run earlier — recommend starting at 5% instead of 10% to be safe.
sam: agree. can we flip to 5% before traffic fans out?
deploy-bot: suggested action: `/deploy set-canary rl-2026-03 5%`
alex: router change does endpoint rewrite for /v2/model -> /v3/model. I'll prep a rollback route that sends traffic to v2 if needed.
sam: doing set-canary now.
```
/deploy set-canary rl-2026-03 5%
```
deploy-bot: executed: canary set to 5% (ts=4023456791) :white_check_mark:
ops-oncall: watching infra. alert rules: errors>0.4% OR p95 latency>400ms => hold.
mira: console logs green at +4m. runtime p95 spiked to 320ms at +7m then settled. nothing to block.
jyoti: note — if p95 > 350ms for 3 contiguous minutes, we should hit manual hold.
sam: plan update: 5% -> 25% after 20m stable. abort path: `/deploy abort rl-2026-03` and pin console/runtime/router back to r2026.2. manual rollback trigger: sam will post `ROLLBACK NOW` in this thread.
alex: router guard ready. I'll apply emergency route that reroutes model traffic to v2 when we hit abort.
```
# emergency rollback curl (ops runbook)
curl -X POST https://router.internal/rewrite -d '{"from":"/v3/model","to":"/v2/model","reason":"rollback rl-2026-03"}' -H 'X-Runbook:rollback'
```
sam: tagged runbook in channel and pinged @ops-oncall.
ops-oncall: ack. I’m on-call and monitoring. will execute abort if sam posts ROLLBACK NOW or if alerts fire.
deploy-bot: canary 5% stable at +12m. metrics: errors=0.02%, p50=45ms, p95=210ms. ready to escalate per plan. :thumbsup:
sam: hold for +8m then escalate to 25% unless anything pops.
alex: small migration delay on my side; request to delay 25% by 10m to finish a prereq check.
sam: delaying escalation to 25% by 10m. if anything degrades we use abort.
mira: I'll update release notes afterwards: console feature-flag X toggled, runtime kernel v3 switchover, router endpoint rewrite. filing notes now.
jyoti: agreed. also adding a short eval run to monitor generation quality post-esc.
sam: thanks all. keep posting short status updates here. if I post `ROLLBACK NOW` we abort immediately.
ops-oncall: standing by. :eyes:
